profile.headline: ML Optimization at Meta
profile.summary:
Performance optimization for MTIA(Meta Training and Inference Accelerator) with compilers.

Most recent work was GenAI Inference Optimization.
I have expertise in E2E optimizations at the graph compiler/kernel/LLVM levels for ML accelerators such as GPU, TPU, and MTIA. My passion lies in squeezing every drip of performance out of hardware based on the architecture.

I have graduated from Carnegie Mellon University in the M.S. of Computer Vision program.

positions.title: Software Engineer, MTIA SW
positions.description:
Inference performance optimization on MTIA for GenAI and Ads model serving.
Graph compiler, disaggregated serving, Tensor/Data/Pipeline/Expert parallelism, memory allocation, dynamic shapes, mixed precision, and more.
Hardware architecture enthusiast.

positions.title: Software Engineer, ML Platform
positions.description:
ML Optimizations using MLIR, XLA.
ML Infrastructure, Runtime, Frameworks, GPU/CPU/TPU Profiling, XLA/Triton kernel authoring for GPU.

positions.title: Capstone Project: Dense Keypoint Detection / Hand Pose Estimation
positions.description: 3D keypoint detection on hands with multi-view hand images, achieved average error less than 1mm.

positions.title: Deep Learning Intern, AI Infrastructure for Autonomous Driving
positions.description: Research on neural network pruning for object detection at the AI Infrastructure Team.

positions.title: Autonomous Driving Research Intern
positions.description: Research on real-time 3D object detection with sparse LIDAR point clouds from the KITTI dataset.

positions.title: Operating Systems Teaching Assistant
positions.description: This course was taught by Professor Byung-Gon Chun.

positions.title: Research Assistant, Software Platform Lab
positions.description: Built a new, scalable stream processing system that handles an excessive number of stream queries efficiently on a distributed environment, while keeping low latency.
